messages:
alex: Quick sync on Private deployment launch slices — want to finalize what must be GA vs staged. Short answers ok.
priya: My vote: GA = installer + static egress IP + DNS override + KMS integration. Everything else opt-in.
mateo: BYO peering/BGP is hard at GA. Can we ship a managed-relay fallback and mark peering for post-GA?
jun: Relay is acceptable to field customers for cutovers; preserves egress IP requirement.
lina: UX ask: surface a consent toggle in the installer UI for any opt-in network features, with audit trail.
carla: From field ops: propose slices -> GA, Pilot (managed relay + consent UI + audit logs), Advanced (peering/BGP). Pilot customers get early access.
priya: Also add a server-side enforcement for consent_toggle (not just UI). Compliance teams insist on it.
mateo: Engineering estimate: GA ~3 sprints (installer refactor + checks). Pilot + relay ~2 sprints. Advanced peering ~4+ sprints.
alex: Good. Quick matrix sketch (Priya pasted):
```
features: [static_egress_ip, dns_override, consent_toggle_ui, audit_logs, managed_relay, peering_bgp]
GA: [static_egress_ip, dns_override, KMS]
Pilot: [consent_toggle_ui, audit_logs, managed_relay]
Advanced: [peering_bgp]
```
carla: Rollout gates: small pilot (10 customers) -> expanded pilot (50) -> GA. Each gate needs checklist and postmortem.
jun: Add an automatic fallback policy: if tenant connectivity checks fail >30s, route to hosted endpoint to avoid outage.
lina: UX recommends a two-step consent flow (UI + email confirm) for critical network changes.
alex: Actions: Mateo list infra blockers for GA (EOD Tue). Priya update notion consent matrix (Wed). Jun draft gating checklist + rollback playbook (Fri). Carla align pilot cust list (Fri).
carla: I'll ping acme/netops for pilot signoff today.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: private-installer-refactor -> canary 2026-04-01T02:00Z (info).
alex: If no objections by EOD we'll lock slices and update roadmap. Any objections?
priya: none.
mateo: none.
jun: none.
lina: none.
carla: none.
alex: Thanks — I'll draft a one-pager for execs and attach notion link.
